title: 2024 Toyota Corolla Trims and Specs Comparison
summary: Compare 2024 Toyota Corolla trim levels, specs, and features. Learn the differences between LE, SE, Nightshade, XSE, and Hybrid trims.
body_markdown:
The **[2024 Toyota Corolla](https://www.cargurus.com/research/2024-Toyota-Corolla-c33099)** upholds its reputation as one of the world's most dependable, fuel-efficient, and practical compact cars. Available in both sedan and hatchback body styles, the 2024 Corolla lineup balances commuter-friendly pricing with modern technology and standard safety gear.


Every 2024 Corolla comes with Toyota Safety Sense 3.0, wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, and an 8-inch Toyota Audio Multimedia touchscreen. Highlights for the 2024 model year include the return of the Nightshade Edition, with bronze wheels and blacked-out exterior accents, alongside an expanded set of hybrid trims and available Electronic On-Demand All-Wheel Drive.


Whether you value fuel economy, daily comfort, sporty styling, or all-weather traction, there's a 2024 Corolla trim built for it.

## 2024 Toyota Corolla Trim Levels Breakdown


### Toyota Corolla LE


The LE is the foundational entry-level sedan in the 2024 lineup, offering strong value with the essential daily tech:


- 2.0-liter 4-cylinder engine producing 169 horsepower and 151 lb-ft of torque
- Dynamic-Shift continuously variable transmission
- 8-inch Toyota Audio Multimedia touchscreen with wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Toyota Safety Sense 3.0 driver-assist suite
- Automatic climate control and remote keyless entry
- 16-inch steel wheels with full covers


The LE covers safety, efficiency, and connectivity for budget-minded commuters.


### Toyota Corolla SE


The SE injects a sportier personality into both the sedan and hatchback, with sharper handling and more aggressive styling:


- 2.0-liter 4-cylinder engine with 169 hp and a Dynamic-Shift CVT with a physical launch gear for snappier off-the-line acceleration
- 18-inch alloy wheels with graphite finish
- Sport mesh front grille, gloss-black accents, and dual chrome-tipped exhaust
- Premium sport seats with fabric inserts and firm side bolsters
- Leather-trimmed steering wheel and Smart Key System with push-button start
- Normal, Eco, and Sport driving modes


### Toyota Corolla Nightshade Edition


Returning for 2024, the Nightshade Edition builds on the SE to deliver distinctive street style across sedan, hatchback, and hybrid models:


- 18-inch bronze-finished alloy wheels
- Blacked-out exterior badging, gloss-black sport mesh grille, and black mirror caps
- Black rear spoiler and lower diffuser accents
- Sport fabric-trimmed seats with dark interior trim
- Available contrasting black roof on hatchback and select sedan colors


### Toyota Corolla XSE


Positioned at the top of the gas lineup on both sedan and hatchback, the XSE blends sporty styling with top-tier comfort:


- 18-inch dark gray alloy wheels and LED fog lights
- SofTex-trimmed heated front sport seats with 8-way power-adjustable driver's seat
- 7-inch fully digital gauge cluster
- Blind Spot Monitor with Rear Cross-Traffic Alert
- Available 9-speaker JBL premium audio system
- Power tilt/slide moonroof with sliding sunshade

### Toyota Corolla Hybrid LE


The Hybrid LE brings the practical value of the LE trim to the hybrid lineup:


- 1.8-liter 4-cylinder hybrid powertrain producing 138 total system horsepower
- EPA-estimated 53 mpg city and 46 mpg highway
- Optional Electronic On-Demand AWD
- Same core tech as the gas LE, including the 8-inch touchscreen and Toyota Safety Sense 3.0


### Toyota Corolla Hybrid SE


The Hybrid SE pairs SE styling and sport tuning with hybrid efficiency:


- 18-inch alloy wheels and sport-tuned suspension
- Sport mesh grille and SE exterior styling
- Available Electronic On-Demand AWD
- Sport seats with leather-trimmed steering wheel


### Toyota Corolla Hybrid Nightshade


The Hybrid Nightshade applies the bronze-and-black treatment to the most efficient powertrain in the lineup:


- 18-inch bronze-finished alloy wheels
- Blacked-out badging, grille, and mirror caps
- Sport fabric-trimmed seats with dark interior trim


### Toyota Corolla Hybrid XLE


The Hybrid XLE is the flagship hybrid sedan and the most comfortable Corolla you can buy:


- SofTex upholstery with heated front seats
- Power-adjustable driver's seat
- Blind Spot Monitor as standard
- Power moonroof
- Front-wheel drive only


## Powertrain & Specs: Gas 2.0L vs. 1.8L Hybrid


Choosing the right Corolla comes down to balancing horsepower against efficiency and drivetrain preference.


### The 2.0L Dynamic Force 4-Cylinder (169 hp)


Standard on LE, SE, Nightshade Edition, and XSE. It makes 169 hp and 151 lb-ft of torque and returns an EPA-estimated 32 mpg city, 41 mpg highway, and 35 mpg combined in LE sedan form. It's efficient for a gas engine and has enough in reserve for confident merging and passing.


### The 1.8L Hybrid Powertrain (138 hp)


Standard on Hybrid LE, Hybrid SE, Hybrid Nightshade, and Hybrid XLE. It makes 138 hp and 105 lb-ft of torque and returns an EPA-estimated 53 mpg city, 46 mpg highway, and 50 mpg combined in front-wheel-drive Hybrid LE form. Hybrid models can also be fitted with Electronic On-Demand All-Wheel Drive, which uses a dedicated rear electric motor to add traction on slippery roads.


## Which 2024 Toyota Corolla Trim is the Best Value?


For traditional gas buyers, the SE hits the sweet spot of value, curb appeal, and daily driving fun. The 18-inch alloy wheels, sport-tuned suspension, launch-gear CVT, and keyless entry lift everyday commuting without a steep jump over the base car.


For commuters focused on long-term fuel savings and all-weather confidence, the Hybrid LE AWD or Hybrid SE is the best value in the lineup. You get 50 mpg combined potential, available all-wheel drive, and standard wireless smartphone integration at an accessible price.


**Our pick:** Choose the SE for value, the Hybrid LE AWD for cold-weather climates, or the XSE or Hybrid XLE if you want heated synthetic leather seats and digital displays.
